verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Nitro page's "HD video streaming" perk, which implies a streaming capability within Discord's voice and hangout spaces. It never explicitly describes sharing your screen during a call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screen sharing in voice calls, details on how to start and control a share and on quality limits for non-Nitro users, admin controls over who may share, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
